Convexity gives the section inclusion for all interpolation weights. Brunn–Minkowski allows nonempty zero-volume endpoints. The equal-base fiber product is compact convex and its linear image has precisely the common-base sections C_z+(-D_z). If there are no common bases the image is empty. Brunn–Minkowski on this image gives root concavity on its projection and, at fixed base, on the two nonempty operands gives the volume-root sum bound.
